adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` inside `createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `event.destinationCalendar`, the branch for a `destination` **without** `credentialId` calls `createEvent(c, event)` (no 3rd arg). After this diff, `createEvent` (in `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts`) propagates the optional `externalId` into the returned `EventResult` as `externalId`, and `EventManager` now stores booking refs using `externalCalendarId: isCalendarType ? result.externalId : undefined` (see the updated mapping blocks around lines ~164/~203). Therefore this legacy path yields `result.externalId === undefined`, so booking references will record `externalCalendarId` as `undefined` even when a `destination.externalId` exists, which can break later update/delete targeting that relies on the stored external calendar id.
